## Spring design

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Wire diameter | 0.022 in |
| Mean coil diameter | 0.230 in |
| Free length | 0.75 in |
| End type | Squared and ground |
| Spring rate | 6.0 lbf/in |

Material: type 302 stainless steel wire (ASTM A313), shear modulus 10.0 × 10⁶ psi.

The Wahl factor is K = 1.14, so the shear stress at 0.55 in is 82,000 psi, below the allowable 126 ksi. Plain ends would need a longer spring. Solid length is 0.264 in, so there is no coil bind. For fatigue, 100,000 cycles is well within the life of this wire.

Factor of safety: 1.5
